add.event: 两家英格兰东北部建房互助社合并组建北岩建房互助社
add.evidence: Northern Rock Building Society was formed in 1965 by the merger of two North East of England building societies

add.event: 两次收购报价均失败后，北岩银行被收归国有
add.evidence: On 22 February 2008, the bank was taken into state ownership as a result of two unsuccessful bids to take over the bank

add.event: 银行被拆分为资产与银行业务两部分
add.evidence: On 1 January 2010 the bank was split into two parts, assets and banking.

add.event: 宣布 Virgin Money 以7.47亿英镑收购 Northern Rock plc
add.evidence: On 17 November 2011, it was announced that Virgin Money was going to buy Northern Rock plc for £747 million.

add.event: 高风险按揭资产 NRAM plc 出售给 Cerberus Capital Management
add.evidence: remained in public ownership until it was sold to Cerberus Capital Management in 2016.
